manifest.author: Kody Wildfeuer
manifest.description: Watches drift-labeled GitHub Issues via the gh CLI and stages each proposed fix as a pull request; proposes only, never merges or closes.
manifest.name: @rapp/drift_watcher

confirm.description: propose: False=DRY-RUN plan (default); True=actually stage the PR

issue.description: propose: the drift Issue number to stage a PR for

label.description: list: Issue label to watch (default rapp-drift)

repo.description: propose: target owner/repo to fix (default from the machine block source)

tracker.description: list: owner/repo holding the drift Issues (default $DRIFT_TRACKER)
